localFields.seedHelp: The same number gives the same image back. Leave it empty to vary.
localFields.temperatureHelp: Low, the model plays safe. High, it takes more chances.
localFields.stepsHelp: More steps refine the image and lengthen the computation.
localFields.framesHelp: How many frames the produced sequence holds.
localFields.secondsHelp: How long the produced sound runs, in seconds.
localFields.imageHelp: Leave it empty to draw from the description alone.
localFields.maskHelp: The painted areas of the mask are the ones the model redoes.
localFields.strengthHelp: Without effect when no starting image is given.
localFields.videoHelp: Leave it empty to compose the sequence from the description alone.
localFields.audioHelp: A 16-bit WAV. Leave it empty to compose from the description alone.

aiModels.empty: No operation has a provider to offer on this machine.
aiModels.appliesNow: A choice made here applies at once — Cancel does not take it back.
aiModels.chooseProvider: No model is chosen for this operation. Nothing is billed until you pick one.
aiModels.notInstalledYet: Install it before it can serve this operation.
aiModels.installHint: Downloads {{size}} of weights onto this machine
aiModels.cancelInstallHint: Stops the download. What already arrived is kept, to resume from
aiModels.removeHint: Deletes the files. The choice that names this model is kept

detail.refused: the format or the provenance of this model is not admitted
detail.runtime: this model is not available on this machine right now
detail.plugin: no engine in this studio can open this model yet
detail.cuda: this model needs an NVIDIA GPU (CUDA)

aiModels.loadHint: Holds the weights in memory so answers come back at once
aiModels.cancelLoadHint: Stops the load and gives back the memory already taken
aiModels.unloadHint: Gives the memory back. The model stays installed on disk
aiModels.loadFailed: The load stopped. Try again, or reinstall the model.
aiModels.loadIncomplete: The model files are missing or unreadable. Reinstall it, then try again.
aiModels.loadNetwork: The load was interrupted. Check the network and try again.
aiModels.installFailed: The install did not finish. You can try again.
aiModels.installFailedNetwork: The download was interrupted. Start it again: what already arrived will be resumed.
aiModels.installFailedChecksum: The file that arrived does not match the model. It was discarded. Try again.
aiModels.forgetHint: Removes the entry from the list. Your file stays where it is
aiModels.ownModelHelp: A weights file already on this machine. The studio does not know its licence.
aiModels.ownModelUnreadable: This file is not a model the studio can read.
aiModels.loadBeyondMachine: Could not load: {{needed}} asked for, {{available}} available.
aiModels.noLocalEngine: No local model for this operation: the catalogue offers none today.
aiModels.sourceStudioHelp: The studio runs the model here. Nothing leaves.
aiModels.sourceOllamaHelp: Ollama is software on this computer. Your images and your text stay here.
aiModels.ollamaHelpMissing: Ollama is not on this computer. Install it here.
aiModels.ollamaHelpDown: Ollama is not open. The studio opens it on its own.
aiModels.ollamaReady_one: {{count, number}} model ready. To pick it, open Assistant further down.
aiModels.ollamaReady_many: {{count, number}} models ready. To pick them, open Assistant further down.
aiModels.ollamaReady_other: {{count, number}} models ready. To pick them, open Assistant further down.
aiModels.installOllamaHint: Downloads the Ollama program onto this computer. Your work stays here.
aiModels.ollamaHelpFailed: The install did not work. Nothing was deleted. You can try again.
aiModels.sourceCloudHelp: Scenario’s servers. The description goes to them.
aiModels.publisherCardHint: Opens this model’s Hugging Face page in the browser
aiModels.catalogueHelp: The models of this family, on this machine and in the cloud. Which one serves each operation is picked in the generation panel.
